comparison.objective: Empty sink-strainer scraps into a caddy and reseat the strainer.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-knob pickup, transport and tipping of a loose-body container, then tight bore reseating.
comparison.success_condition: All nine scraps in caddy, basket reseated within 4 mm/8°, hands clear, still 1 s; drain loss, counter spill, basket loss, or dropping permanently zeros.
comparison.reason: This is the closest manipulation overlap because it transfers multiple loose bodies by tipping and reseats their container, but it does not test selective passage through apertures while retaining a second object class; all scraps are transferred together.
